reason: The preregistered mathematical map agrees with Algorithm 1 of arXiv:2305.10803v2, but several numerical definitions were not unique enough to implement without post-input discretion. This amendment resolves only those definitions before an S4 input is materialized; it does not change the candidate family, development strata, budgets, advancement gates or claim boundary.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: A gap ratio alone can label a regular but ill-conditioned close root as singular, and the preregistered rank_roundoff_multiplier otherwise had no defined use.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Use the frozen roundoff-scaled retained-value cutoff and unique smallest-gap split rule below. A full-rank split is ineligible, and the separate final null-decay gate rejects a persistent discarded singular value.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: The mixed-direction exponent was frozen but the absolute scaling and reserve stencil were not.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Use the normalized-direction four-corner stencil and the two frozen radii below.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: The principal-angle comparison set and the provenance of U2, V2 and v after the range step were implicit.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Require all six pairwise comparisons among the four route decompositions, and retain the current-iterate J(x) bases through both steps. Recomputing a nullspace at x_range is forbidden.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: Read literally, sharing only ledger and semantic replay types would forbid the candidate and control from consuming the same frozen endpoint, oracle and counter schedule.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Frozen case data, the residual/target oracle, work-ledger type, semantic replay type and declared counter formula are common experimental inputs. Candidate and control share no Jacobian, Hessian, SVD, projected-operator, solve, convergence or error-estimation implementation helper.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: The analytic Hessian-direction callback had no explicit callback charge.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Every analytic Jacobian or analytic Hessian-direction invocation costs one callback; every C2 residual or target invocation costs one callback. Numeric derivative constructions receive no uncharged synthetic callback.

route_definition.rank_cutoff: tau_rank=32*n*eps(T)*max(1,sigma_1(J)) for the preregistered square systems
route_definition.rank_selection: With singular values in descending order, r is the smallest index 1<=r<n for which sigma_(r+1)/sigma_r<=1e-6 and sigma_r>tau_rank. No qualifying index, zero retained directions, or k=n-r>4 is typed unknown. Exactly the same r is required at 128 and 256 bits and radius multipliers 1 and 0.5. Equality with the gap bound passes; equality with tau_rank fails.
route_definition.principal_angle_definition: The reference is the decomposition at the same endpoint with (precision_bits=256,radius_multiplier=0.5). For two equal-dimensional orthonormal bases Qref and Q, sin(theta_max)=sqrt(max(0,1-sigma_min(Qref'*Q)^2)). The maximum left-nullspace value and maximum right-nullspace value over the other three route probes must each be <=1e-6.
route_definition.route_residual_goal: semantic_residual_tolerance/(4*error_reserve_multiplier), equal to 1.5625e-14 under the frozen controls
route_definition.nonfinite_or_ambiguous: Any nonfinite singular value, zero retained boundary value, dimension disagreement or non-unique cutoff result fails closed.
route_definition.final_null_decay_gate: At the final audit, normalized_discarded_sigma=max(sigma_(r+1),...,sigma_n)/max(1,sigma_1) and normalized_last_step=norm(x_final-x_previous,Inf)/max(1,norm(x_final,Inf)). At both precisions and both Jacobian radii require normalized_discarded_sigma<=16*(normalized_last_step^2+eps(T)^(2/3)). This fail-closed applicability check prevents a regular close root with a persistent small singular value from being presented as S4 evidence; it is not a proof of multiplicity or isolation. Persist both normalized quantities, the bound and the Boolean decision for every probe.

two_step_definition.frozen_nullity: The eligible endpoint route fixes k for the complete primary and confirmation run. At an outer iteration, the trailing k singular vectors and leading n-k retained vectors of the charged J(x) are used; k is not redetected or retuned from the iterate.
two_step_definition.basis_lifetime: Compute J(x)=U*Sigma*V'. Form x_range with U1,Sigma1,V1. The U2,V2 below and v=V2*c are from this same J(x). They remain unchanged while evaluating J(x_range), B and the null step. No SVD or basis replacement at x_range is permitted.
two_step_definition.counter_coefficients: Use the fixed namespace 0x53342d43322d5631. For one-based null coordinate j and one-based trajectory-local iteration ell, initialize z=namespace xor (UInt64(k)<<48) xor (UInt64(ell)<<16) xor UInt64(j), then apply SplitMix64 exactly: z+=0x9e3779b97f4a7c15; z=(z xor (z>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9; z=(z xor (z>>27))*0x94d049bb133111eb; u=z xor (z>>31). Set magnitude=1+Int(u & 0x7fffffff), sign=+1 when bit 63 is zero and -1 otherwise, a_j=sign*magnitude, and c=T.(a)/norm(T.(a),2). Precision, representation, case/family/Gold identity and confirmation index are not inputs. Persist c and v in every iteration trace. Candidate and control duplicate this formula rather than share a helper.
two_step_definition.range_step: Solve Sigma1*y=U1'*F(x), then x_range=x-V1*y; no explicit inverse and no normal equations.
two_step_definition.mixed_direction_step: Let rho=m*eps(T)^(1/4)*max(1,norm(x_range,Inf)). For v use h=rho/max(norm(v,Inf),sqrt(eps(T))); for V2[:,j] use k_j=rho/max(norm(V2[:,j],Inf),sqrt(eps(T))). The candidate uses m=1 inside each trajectory iteration and uses m in {1,0.5} for initial-route and final audits.
two_step_definition.mixed_direction_stencil: D2F(x_range)[a,b] is estimated as (F(x+h*a+kappa*b)-F(x+h*a-kappa*b)-F(x-h*a+kappa*b)+F(x-h*a-kappa*b))/(4*h*kappa). Each corner is a separately charged canonical residual call.
two_step_definition.projected_operator: B[:,j]=U2'*D2F(x_range)[v,V2[:,j]]. The candidate uses m=1 to supply each trajectory step. Initial-route and final audits require the m=1 and m=0.5 operators to agree on full rank and the frozen condition gate. The analytic control has no finite-difference radius and obtains B from its independent analytic second-directional callback.
two_step_definition.projected_rank_cutoff: tau_B=32*k*eps(T)^(1/2)*max(1,sigma_1(B)). Both radius operators must have exactly k singular values strictly above tau_B and condition number <=1e12. Otherwise the trajectory is typed unknown.
two_step_definition.null_step: Evaluate a charged radius-1 C2 J(x_range), solve B*delta=-U2'*J(x_range)*v without an explicit inverse, and set x_next=x_range+V2*delta.
two_step_definition.failed_probe: An outer iteration is charged before its first oracle call. Any later domain, guard, nonfinite, factorization, rank, condition, callback, iteration or deadline failure consumes all work already incurred and returns typed unknown.

work_ledger.scope: one variant on one endpoint, shared by route probes, both primary precisions, all confirmations, final audits, convergence diagnostics, target-gradient/error work and canonical semantic replay
work_ledger.numeric_jacobian_charge: 2*n residual callbacks per central Jacobian; there is no additional Jacobian callback
work_ledger.numeric_projected_column_charge: 4 residual callbacks per mixed-direction column per radius
work_ledger.analytic_hessian_direction_charge: one residual-vector callback per direction pair; the returned vector must have residual_dimension entries and every entry must be finite, otherwise fail closed after charging

shared: frozen endpoint and Gold-hidden residual/target input
frozen trajectory starts and coefficient formula
work-ledger and canonical semantic replay types
artifact field names and final advancement predicates
must_be_separately_coded: rank rule, SVD split and principal-angle diagnostics
projected-B assembly, range solve and null solve
independent_control_boundary.candidate_visibility: The candidate receives CandidateInput only and cannot receive the analytic Hessian-direction control object.

freeze_order: Commit this amendment and an input-only generator while no S4 candidate/control implementation exists.
After the host-exclusive performance run ends, execute static/input tests and materialize s4-development-input-manifest.json.
Commit the immutable manifest and s4-input-freeze.json, including source, card and amendment hashes.
Only from the committed input-freeze parent may candidate and analytic-control implementation begin.
Freeze implementation and applicability hashes before the first development outcome.
Do not materialize locked inputs unless the unchanged development gate passes.
